technique "MainTech0" mmdpass=object usetexture=any usespheremap=any usetoon=any subset=all hardware=1 shadercaps=1 shadermix=1 script=1 empty=0 passes=1
  script "RenderColorTarget0=;RenderColorTarget1=LightSpecMap;RenderColorTarget2=LightAlphaMap;Pass=DrawObject;"
  cmd 0 RenderColorTarget0 param="-" value=0 text=""
  cmd 1 RenderColorTarget1 param="LightSpecMap" value=-1 text="LightSpecMap"
  cmd 2 RenderColorTarget2 param="LightAlphaMap" value=-1 text="LightAlphaMap"
  cmd 3 Pass pass="DrawObject" index=0 text="DrawObject"
  pass 0 "DrawObject" script=0 custom=1 psize15=0 shadermix=1
technique "MainTechBS0" mmdpass=object_ss usetexture=any usespheremap=any usetoon=any subset=all hardware=1 shadercaps=1 shadermix=1 script=1 empty=0 passes=1
  script "RenderColorTarget0=;RenderColorTarget1=LightSpecMap;RenderColorTarget2=LightAlphaMap;Pass=DrawObject;"

  # name! = the technique matched but is invalid (fallback); - = no technique
  # modes 0 and 1 list the eight Use* states: index = usetexture | usespheremap<<1 | usetoon<<2
  select object 0-1 "MainTech0" "MainTech0" "MainTech0" "MainTech0" "MainTech0" "MainTech0" "MainTech0" "MainTech0"
  select object_ss 0-1 "MainTechBS0" "MainTechBS0" "MainTechBS0" "MainTechBS0" "MainTechBS0" "MainTechBS0" "MainTechBS0" "MainTechBS0"
  select shadow 0-1 "ShadowTech"
  select edge 0-1 "EdgeTec"
  select zplot 0-1 "ZplotTec"
